intraday_rationale: Current open position on EURUSD is already active with existing risk. Across other major asset classes (Gold, Bitcoin, Indices), candles show mixed consolidation ranges and low volume expansion on the 15-minute timeframe, failing to provide the required clean momentum run and 1:2.5+ risk-reward setup.
learning_applied: Avoiding premature entries during low volume consolidation phases and respecting account margin limitations by not stacking secondary risk while an open position is managing a drawdown.
